held.detail: no verified backup of this log has been recorded, and the policy asks for one every 24h; the trim has not advanced for 46h, and the log is keeping up to 1200 record(s) older than its 24h replay window
held.remedy: Run `crewlet backup` against any node, whatever its roles, and check whatever was meant to run it; under `backup_floor: operator`, acknowledge each named log's off-host copy with `crewlet retention ack -stream <its stream> -position <n>`, n being the sequence the copy reaches. The trim does not advance a log past a backup older than the policy, and does not advance it at all until there is one.
